question: Break down net sales by segment (Walmart U.S., Walmart International, Sam's Club) and say which segment grew fastest and which had the highest operating margin.

answer.summary: Walmart's FY2024 consolidated net sales were $642.64B [F00003], up 6.1% YoY [F00003]. By segment: Walmart U.S. generated $441.82B (68.8% of total) [F00958], Walmart International generated $114.64B (17.8% of total) [F00959], and Sam's Club generated $86.18B (13.4% of total) [F00960]. Walmart International grew fastest in FY2024 at +13.5% YoY [F00959], versus Walmart U.S. at +5.1% [F00958] and Sam's Club at +2.2% [F00960]. Segment-level operating margin is not reported in the retrieved evidence; only consolidated operating margin is available, which was 4.2% in FY2024 [F01838], up from 3.4% in FY2023 [F01837]. The narrative notes Walmart U.S. has historically had the highest gross profit as a percentage of net sales [T00090], but this is gross profit, not operating margin.
drivers: Walmart U.S. was the largest contributor to the FY2024 total change, accounting for 58% of the $36.76B (+6.1%) increase, with its $21.26B change [F00958]
Walmart International contributed 37% of the total change with its $13.66B (+13.5%) growth [F00959]
Sam's Club contributed 5% of the total change with its $1.83B (+2.2%) growth [F00960]
risks_and_red_flags: Segment-level operating margin is not disclosed in the retrieved evidence; only consolidated operating margin (4.2% FY2024 [F01838]) is available, so the question of which segment had the highest operating margin cannot be answered from this filing
Sam's Club growth slowed materially to +2.2% in FY2024 from +14.7% in FY2023 [F00960], partially offset by lower fuel sales due to deflation [T00478]
Walmart U.S. unit counts declined -2.2% YoY in FY2024 to 4.62B [F01323], indicating store count contraction
data_quality_notes: The OperatingIncomeLoss segment slice [F01685] ($2.02B) is mislabeled: it references table 74 (aggregate annual lease obligations), not segment operating income, so it cannot be used as a segment operating margin component
19 duplicate facts with conflicting values were set aside during parsing; the primary-statement value was kept

The narrative states Walmart U.S. has the highest gross profit as % of net sales [T00090] and Sam's Club has a lower gross profit rate [T00135], but gross profit rate is not the same as operating margin

outlook.forward_looking_guidance: No forward-looking management guidance is present in the retrieved evidence; all figures are FY2024 actuals
